usageNotes: Use this endpoint to append a new firewall rule to a specific SDN VNet's ruleset. The caller must hold SDN.Allocate on the vnet's zone path ('/sdn/zones/<zone>/<vnet>'); without it the call returns 403. Rules are appended at the end by default — use 'pos' to insert at a specific index (0-based). The call returns null on success, so confirm insertion by reading back the rules list.

examples.summary: Block all inbound traffic from a known malicious subnet to vnet 'prod01'

tips: The vnet identifier must be 2–8 alphanumeric characters starting with a letter — single-char names are rejected.
Rules are evaluated top-down; insert at 'pos' 0 to make a rule take effect before existing ones.
Use 'macro' (e.g. 'SSH', 'HTTP') to avoid specifying proto/dport manually for common services.
Set 'enable' to 0 to add a rule in disabled state for testing before activating it.
SDN firewall rules live at the cluster level and apply across all nodes — changes take effect cluster-wide after the next SDN apply cycle.
Use 'digest' from a prior GET to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.
